value.answer: Assuming you mean Oakville, Ontario: the Oakville Costco isn't open yet, it's expected later in 2027. The closest open one I found is in Burlington at 1225 Brant St, phone (905) 336-6714. Hours for today look inconsistent between sources, so call ahead before going.
